tagline: Soft faux fur for your dog, and brown herringbone tweed for your living room.
lead: Your dog can flop on from any side and stretch full length on soft faux fur, with no walls in the way.
value: The cover is the part you look at every day and wash most often. Tweed, faux fur and leather handles last longer than printed polyester.
intro: Chestnut is an open orthopaedic dog mattress in brown herringbone tweed, with a faux-fur sleeping surface over a foam core, leather handles, a non-slip base and a removable, machine-washable cover. Medium and Large.
points: They can flop on from any direction and stretch out full length.
A soft sleeping surface over a foam core.
A herringbone body with leather handles, so moving it takes one hand.
A non-slip base, and a cover that comes off for the machine.
best_for: Dogs who sprawl and would rather not climb into a bed, in homes where the bed lives in the living room.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. The whole surface is usable, so there's no allowance for bolsters. Ask us for exact measurements, or which size suits their breed and weight.
care: Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. The leather handles have their own care instructions. Air-dry fully before refitting.
seo_title: Tweed Orthopaedic Dog Mattress, Faux Fur Top | Snoozly
seo_description: An open orthopaedic dog mattress with a soft faux-fur top, in brown herringbone tweed. Foam core, leather handles, washable cover. Medium and Large.
